content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (§ 12.4, paragraph p0051).**

§ 12.4 is a one-way non-solicit binding only us, and it fails the fallback on every material term: 18 months rather than 12, all Vendor employees at any time during the term rather than personnel involved in the services, "solicit or engage" (an effective no-hire, which is walk-away territory), and no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out. It also contradicts § 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we have made no no-hire commitment.

Redline (validated, preferred level): delete § 12.4, with the narrow mutual 12-month fallback offered in the comment as a compromise.
